questions.question: When John fell down to worship the angel who showed him his visions, who did the angel tell him to worship?
Jesus says He is coming soon and His reward is with Him. How does He give it to each person?

answers.text: By what each one has done
By how long each one waited
By the city each one is from

questions.question: In John's vision, Jesus says He is coming soon. Who does He say is blessed?

answers.text: Whoever keeps the words of this book
Whoever sees an angel up close

questions.question: In John's vision of Jesus coming soon, those who wash their robes are blessed with the right to what?
